target: forge.sh kind — a declared kind wins even with no usable remote, else none
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE_REMOTE=ghost
fx_run kind; echo "ghost_undeclared=$FX_OUT"
export FORGE=github; fx_run kind; echo "ghost_declared=$FX_OUT"; unset FORGE FORGE_REMOTE
fx_config '{"forge":{"remote":"ghost"}}'
fx_run kind; echo "cfg_ghost=$FX_OUT"
fx_config '{"forge":{"remote":"ghost","kind":"gitlab"}}'
fx_run kind; echo "cfg_declared=$FX_OUT"
rm -rf .agentic; git remote remove origin
export FORGE=gitlab; fx_run kind; echo "noremote_declared=$FX_OUT"; unset FORGE
fx_run kind; echo "noremote_undeclared=$FX_OUT"
fx_done
